description: Defines interface classes for formatter plugins used in the behave BDD testing framework, including detailed method signatures for processing features, scenarios, steps, and rules.

classes.name: IFormatter
classes.description: Interface class for formatter implementations, providing methods for processing features, scenarios, steps, rules, backgrounds, and results.

classes.name: IFormatter2
classes.description: Simplified interface class for formatter implementations with methods for test run, file, feature, rule, scenario, and step lifecycle events.

methods.name: uri
methods.description: Method called before processing a feature file, with the URI or filename.

methods.name: feature
methods.description: Method called before executing a feature.

methods.name: rule
methods.description: Method called before executing a rule.

methods.name: background
methods.description: Deprecated method called when a background is provided, after feature() and before scenarios.

methods.name: scenario
methods.description: Method called before executing a scenario.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Method called before executing a step.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Method called when a step is matched to its implementation.

methods.name: result
methods.description: Method called after a step has been processed, with its result.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Method called after processing a feature or feature file.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Method to close the formatter's stream, called before disposal.

methods.name: on_testrun_start
methods.description: Method called at the start of a test run.

methods.name: on_testrun_end
methods.description: Method called at the end of a test run.

methods.name: on_file_start
methods.description: Method called at the start of processing a file.

methods.name: on_file_end
methods.description: Method called at the end of processing a file.

methods.name: on_feature_start
methods.description: Method called at the start of a feature.

methods.name: on_feature_end
methods.description: Method called at the end of a feature.

methods.name: on_rule_start
methods.description: Method called at the start of a rule.

methods.name: on_rule_end
methods.description: Method called at the end of a rule.

methods.name: on_scenario_start
methods.description: Method called at the start of a scenario.

methods.name: on_scenario_end
methods.description: Method called at the end of a scenario.

methods.name: on_step_start
methods.description: Method called at the start of a step.

methods.name: on_step_end
methods.description: Method called at the end of a step.
